# D04 — GAME + TASTE: sources

Thin protocol: two external repositories and one accepted internal part. Stars
are GitHub API values on 2026-11-25. No code or prose copied.

| # | Repository | Stars | License | Analog | Borrowed | Rejected |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | https://github.com/Anuken/Mindustry | 29,973 | GPL-3.0 | A game whose feel is described after play | The order: fantasy, three-step loop, feel, audience, anti-rules; a page that describes a build, not a pitch | The tech tree, the content volume, the GPL code |
| 2 | https://github.com/mailchimp/content-style-guide | 565 | NOASSERTION (GitHub) | Editorial style guide | Five concrete words, each tied to an example; “a word that fits any game is not a word” | Brand voice rules, grammar tables |
| 3 | G0 concept brief (internal, accepted) | n/a | project-internal | The pre-G1 contract | The audience and the promise that `GAME.md` must keep after G1 | The open questions that G0 already closed |

## Considered and rejected

- `Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios` (40,885★, MIT) — a full studio template;
  too much for a one-page orientation.
- `game-programming-patterns` (4,583★, MIT) — code patterns, not player-facing
  language.
- `ncase/polygons` (1,400★) — a visual reference, not a writing model.

## License note

Mindustry is GPL-3.0; only the descriptive order is borrowed, no code or text.
The Mailchimp guide reports NOASSERTION; only the “five concrete words” idea is
borrowed. G0 is project-internal.
